deviations.what: keysets clear --apply becomes an audited mutating verb (keysets.clear): its deletes run in one store transaction with exactly one audit entry (identity, set, key or whole set, count), and it joins the registry-wide audit test; t3 shipped it unaudited, like variable writes
deviations.reason: a cleared set is destructive and hard to reverse (only a re-seed restores it) and, unlike a variable, leaves no version history of who cleared what; the decider (assess, 0.946 then 0.964 with the effort and trace facts removed) and the operator chose to audit it in this PR

deviations.what: keyset.filter and keyset.add gain an optional items_field setting: items may be a list of loop output objects (one per iteration, e.g. {results: [...]}), and items_field names the field holding each one's items; a None entry is an iteration with no items; filter keeps the shape (objects keep their other fields, None stays None). Without it, keyset.add placed after a for_each loop stored 0 keys silently
deviations.reason: t5's flow test showed a for_each loop's results port carries each iteration's last step output object, not a list of items, and per-port lists carry None for a skipped iteration; c23 assumed lists of lists. No field name is built in: the live newspaper config sets items_field: results on the add before record

deviations.what: keyset.add fails bad_params when it is given at least one item and none yields a key (zero items stays a success), and outputs a keyless count beside added and already_present; keyset.filter is unchanged (it keeps keyless items and counts them)
deviations.reason: t5 showed a misconfigured add (missing items_field) completes with added 0 and stores nothing, so the next issue repeats every link with no failure anywhere; the decider (assess: fail_all_keyless 0.789, count_only 0.148; failing filter too 0.249) favoured failing the all-keyless case; a mix with some keyless items stays normal, and a flow can still set on_error skip

deviations.what: Refines d3: keyset.add does not fail on all-keyless input; it fails bad_params only when a keyless item holds a list-valued field (a loop output object, so items_field is probably missing), with a hint to set items_field; plain keyless items are skipped and counted in a new keyless output
deviations.reason: building d3 showed a filter-then-add run fails on an ordinary day when only keyless items survive the filter; re-assessed (fail_on_loop_shape 0.889, fail_all_keyless 0.068; the keyless-survivor case is ordinary at 0.880). d3 should be rejected in favour of this

deviations.what: Code review on PR #119 tightens d2/d4: keyset.filter refuses a loop-shaped keyless item too (it kept them all silently); only a keyless item holding a non-empty list of objects counts as loop-shaped (a tags list of strings no longer fails an add); a None inside a flat list of objects is no item (dropped) instead of refusing the step; window_days is bounded at 36500 (bad_params instead of an OverflowError)
deviations.reason: the review showed filter could still filter nothing silently on the shape d4 guards in add, d4's list check refused ordinary items with list fields (the d3 failure mode), and a None in a flat list or a huge window failed or crashed instead of being handled
